verdict.rationale: Factory explicitly documents `droid exec` as a one-shot CLI command designed for CI/CD pipelines and batch processing, with tiered autonomy controls for unattended operation, directly matching the story of triggering an agent from CI to fix builds/tests. Missing for 10: X, Y — no independent/hands-on case study of a real CI pipeline invoking droid exec to fix a failing test, and no explicit example config for popular CI systems (GitHub Actions, etc.).
